name: manifest_inspect
description: Show what kaika recorded about one installed package: source, version, where it came from, and its pin.

name: pin_version
description: Pin a package to one version so upgrades skip it.

version.description: Version to stay on, for example 22.1.0

name: unpin
description: Remove a package's pin so upgrades may change it again.

name: cleanup_cache
description: Delete kaika's own cached downloads or unpacking folders to free disk space.

name: retry_install
description: Retry installing a package from a specific source after a failure.
